items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In New Jersey. Ann Person. [INTERVIEWEE] Ann Person. My sister was fortunate enough to be the first one to go into Marshall Field's...

ctx.x: Ann Person. My sister was fortunate enough to be the first one to go into Marshall Field's, Milt, you know about Chicago, not as a domestic, because you remember/- you know how Marshall Field's felt about black people. She went in as a milliner and she went in and she also began to make hats. Then for three years she was special dietician for the Merit chain, you know, the Merit cafeteria system. She was a special dietician for them, and also/connected with Know Your City, and to be - to come from Craine…
